symptom: Director repair changed a Go API on an already-red workspace and expanded two compiler diagnostics into failures across multiple packages.

dynamic_debug_evidence.before: Two Go compile diagnostics in the exact same-run repair input.
dynamic_debug_evidence.after: go test ./... reported assignment mismatches and undefined symbols in root, bubbletea, physics, and sandbox packages.
dynamic_debug_evidence.old_gate_behavior: candidate shadow compile skipped and mutation accepted

root_cause: candidate_compile_gate only compared candidates when the baseline compiled, treating any red baseline as permission for an unbounded mutation.
fix: Always run the Go shadow candidate; reject proven diagnostic-count expansion while allowing compile success, diagnostic reduction, or bounded same-count forward-unmask.
residual_risk: Equal-count semantic substitutions remain allowed and must be bounded by effect receipts, diagnosis hashes, and verifier progress.
